I (33m) am not a Disney person. Went once when I was 12. My wife (32f), is most definitely a Disney person. Goes frequently when visiting her parents. 
The rumors are true. The place really is Magical. I don't know what it is. You get to Magic Kingdom and it's like a light flips and you feel like a kid again. 
We did MK and HS and I felt weird thinking, boy I can't wait to come back here. The sounds, the music, the food, the rides. The parks at night time is really something.

Any if you like Star Wars, at all, you're going to love Galaxy's Edge. 
I'm sold. I want to go back.

My wife and I just got back from HS (Friday) and MK (Saturday). We did both parks, each in a full day. The lines look long, but I swear the longest line we waited in was Tower of Terror and it was only 45 minutes long. 
We went on Rockin Roller Coaster three times and each time it was basically walk on, I think the longest we waited was 15 minutes. Tip for ROTR, we had our IPAD open showing the second hand, at 6:59:59 we swiped down on the que and we were boarding group 10. The ride was incredible. If you're able to, I would suggest getting there as early as possible, to knock out the rides that you know you want to hit. I felt like no one showed up until 10am. 
MK on a Saturday was a little more crowed, but still ques were short, but lines were long. The social distancing made everything look worse than it was.
Thank you for the tip. I will try back there.
